## MYCOBACTERIUM AVIUM PNEUMONIA
Diagnosis and treatment are complex. Regimens containing 3 or 4 drugs are
usually recommended, but two drug regimens may be sufficient in some cases.
Consult Infectious Diseases and/or Pulmonary in all cases.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Treatment is continued until sputum cultures are consecutively negative for 12
months.
## Three-drug regimens
Preferred treatment
## Inpatient

[Clarithromycin 500 mg PO q12h ($) [R,DI] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h](orz-set-abx-clarithromycin-ethambutol-rifabutin)
($$) [R] <AND> rifabutin 300 mg PO q24h ($$) [R,DI]
Alternative
[Azithromycin 250 mg PO q24h ($) M <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h [R]](orz-set-abx-azith-250-ethambutol-rifabutin-300)
<AND> rifabutin 300 mg q24h ($$) [R,DI]
## Four-drug regimens may be recommended for advanced (severe) or previously
## treated disease-Consult Infectious Diseases
## Outpatient Preferred

treatment
[Clarithromycin 500 mg PO BID ($) [R,DI] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO QDay](orz-set-abx-op-clarith-500-ethamb-15-rifabutin-300)
($$) [R] <AND> rifabutin 300 mg PO QDay ($$) [R,DI]
[Non-VA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-clarith-500-ethamb-15-rifabutin-300)
Alternative
[Azithromycin 250 mg PO QDay ($) M <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO QDay [R]](orz-set-abx-op-azith-250-ethamb-15-rifabutin-300)
<AND> rifabutin 300 mg QDay ($$) [R,DI]
